{{Quote|Mine! Mine! This race is mine! Those filthy cheaters keep making my beautiful droid lose!|translated=1|Sapaaga after Racer CGK-0 lost another race|<ref name="The Grand Acquisitions Race" />}}
'''Sapaaga''', also known as '''Sapaaga the Hutt''', was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] that was known to bet on the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] races on the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] [[Promenade]]. During the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]], Sapaaga acquired a black and orange sphere which was one of the items hidden by the [[Chevin Conglomerate]]. After his betting gonk droid [[Racer CGK-0]] lost several races to cheaters, he offered to give the sphere away to anyone that would punish his opponents and let the droid win.

==Behind the scenes==
Sapaaga the Hutt made his first appearance in hologram form in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the [[2012]] world event "The Grand Acquisitions Race."<ref name="The Grand Acquisitions Race" />
